en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moala Bin Muhammad, from Al Washa, 
(It has been narrated) from Is’haq son of Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> who said, ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said to me:
‘O my<sup>asws</sup> son! Take the sheep and do not take the camel’.
en.sarwar: 1. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu‘alla’ ibn Muhammad from al-Washsha’ from Ishaq ibn Ja‘far who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, once said to me,
‘Son, keep sheep but do not keep camels.’”
